# WF24 · Thu ngân · lọc "Còn phải thu"

Group **WF · Thu ngân & lên đơn** · state · Next.js: **built (U5)** (`/cashier`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/operations-ui.js#cashier`
- Cashier is `operations-ui.js › cashier()`; the quick-order dialog and the order history are `order-ui.js`; the A5 review page is `order-review/index.html` + `order-review.js`; data and rules are `order-data.js`.
- `operations-ui.js › cashier()` with `invoiceFilter = 'due'` (button `data-ops="invoice-filter" data-value="due"`): `received < amount`. The selected filter is the primary button (the other two are secondary); there are no chip elements. Every shown row has "Thu tiền". Rows per page: 12 (`invoicePage`), the footer reads "12 hóa đơn · Trang 1/1" with "← Trước" and "Sau →" disabled.
- Inventory note: Invoice list filtered to the 12 invoices with an open balance (every row has "Thu tiền"). The filter "Đã thanh toán" and the paging buttons ("← Trước", "Sau →") change only the rows.
- Page key `cashier` is allowed for roles: owner, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- Controls removed for roles without the capability: `ops=pay` needs `billing` (roles owner/accountant); `ops=quick-order` needs `billing` (roles owner/accountant).
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"cashier\"]"} → {"click":"[data-ops=\"invoice-filter\"][data-value=\"due\"]"}; it must show "12 hóa đơn".

## Required text (keep verbatim)
- Chưa có đơn từ catalog. (empty state)

## Business rules
- "AI chỉ là bản nháp" principle for orders: a draft needs the responsible doctor's approval before it is printed or shown in the patient app ("Đơn nháp cần bác sĩ duyệt trước khi in.").
- "12 hóa đơn · Trang 1/1" (pagination line; the filter "Đã thanh toán" and the paging buttons only change the rows)

## Differences from the app design
- App I10 draws the same three filters as `PemaFilterChip` ("Tất cả", "Còn phải thu", "Đã thanh toán") and cards instead of a table; it has no pagination (the web pages by 12) and no order history block.

## Gotchas
- The table here also shows the first demo invoice HD-DEMO-001 (Tái khám & đánh giá, 300.000 ₫, 150.000 ₫ received).
- Stats do not follow the filter: Tổng hóa đơn 48 and Còn phải thu 11.250.000 ₫ are always totals.
- Canvas draws 5 of the 12 due invoices; the paging line keeps the old count "12 hóa đơn · Trang 1/1".

- Frames: 1440x900 (inventory: 1440x900); screen label `WF24 · Thu ngân · lọc "Còn phải thu"`.
